post.title: It Won't Hurt As Long As You Think #shorts
post.description: Been there? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who thinks it's over. Omar loses the final and is sure he'll be miserable for months. In 'Immune Neglect: A Source of Durability Bias in Affective Forecasting' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1998), Daniel Gilbert, Elizabeth Pinel, Timothy Wilson, Stephen Blumberg and Thalia Wheatley found across six studies (a breakup, being denied tenure, losing an election, a job rejection and more) that people overestimate how long bad events will hurt. Young professors predicted years of unhappiness if denied tenure; former professors who had been denied were about as happy as those who were promoted. We forget our psychological immune system, the ways the mind quietly helps us cope. #psychology #shorts #impactbias #affectiveforecasting #overthinking
